backend/main.mo: Main backend canister implementing HarvestSync's core logic with user profiles, harvest listings, commitments, transport offers, buyer demands, crop analysis, and AI-powered predictive analytics using mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting deployment verification requirements with references to dashboard files, components, and test ID REQ-94.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including styling, routing, dashboards, modals, and card components with notes about removed duplicate Layout wrappers.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode CSS variables for agricultural green-themed UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the HarvestSync React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing authentication flow, profile setup, role-based dashboard routing (Farmer/Buyer/Transporter), and query client provider with loading states.
frontend/src/components/AcceptBuyerDeman: Modal dialog allowing farmers to accept buyer demands by selecting one of their harvest listings with demand details display and form submission.
frontend/src/components/BuyerCommitmentC: Card component displaying buyer commitment details including listing info, quantity, price, harvest date, readiness score, and accepted transport tracking status.
frontend/src/components/BuyerCommitments: Displays a buyer's list of pre-harvest commitments with loading states and empty state messaging. Renders commitments in a responsive grid using BuyerCommitmentCard components.
Card component displaying buyer demand details (crop type, quantity, price, location) with status badges and conditional "Accept Demand" button for farmers. Opens AcceptBuyerDemandModal when farmers interact with open demands.
frontend/src/components/BuyerListingCard: Displays harvest listing details for buyers including ML-enhanced readiness scores, quality grades, crop diagnosis, and predicted yield/price. Provides a "Make Commitment" button that opens MakeCommitmentModal.
frontend/src/components/CommitmentStatus: Simple badge component that displays commitment status as either "Pending" (0 commitments) or "X Committed" with appropriate icons and styling.
frontend/src/components/CreateHarvestLis: Modal form for farmers to create harvest listings with fields for crop details, growth cycle, and quality assessment. Includes integration with photo analysis and voice input modals for enhanced data entry.
frontend/src/components/CropDiagnosisMod: Modal allowing farmers to upload or capture crop photos for AI-powered diagnosis. Manages camera functionality, file uploads, and displays diagnosis results via CropDiagnosisResultsCard.
frontend/src/components/CropDiagnosisRes: Displays comprehensive AI crop diagnosis results including quality grade, harvest readiness score, disease/pest detection, and market price predictions. Provides visual indicators for severity and impact of detected issues.
frontend/src/components/CropPhotoAnalysi: Modal component for uploading crop photos and using AI to analyze crop maturity, returning a readiness score with breakdown by color, texture, and size. Allows applying the analyzed score to a listing.
frontend/src/components/FarmerListingCar: Card component displaying a farmer's harvest listing with readiness score, commitments, and transport offers. Provides functionality to delete listings and accept transport offers for specific commitments.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright information and attribution to caffeine.ai with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with HarvestSync branding, user profile display when authenticated, and login button.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that combines Header, Footer, and children content in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/ListingFilters.t: Filter component for harvest listings with search by crop type, location (village-wise), and checkbox to show only quality-certified harvests. Filters are applied in real-time.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and error handling for duplicate authentication.
frontend/src/components/MakeCommitmentMo: Modal form for buyers to make pre-harvest commitments by specifying quantity and offer price for a specific harvest listing.
frontend/src/components/MakeTransportOff: Modal form for transporters to offer logistics services for a harvest listing, specifying vehicle type, load capacity, and route details.
Modal dialog for buyers to post crop demand with fields for crop type, quantity, price per kg, and destination. Submits demand via useCreateBuyerDemand mutation and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/PredictiveAnalyt: Displays AI-powered predictions for harvest yield and market price based on crop type, location, and growth cycle data. Shows forecasted values in a card with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Non-dismissible modal for new users to complete profile setup with name, contact, location, and role selection (Farmer/Buyer/Transporter). Submits via useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/RouteOptimizerMo: Modal for transporters to optimize multi-farm pickup routes using AI. Takes vehicle capacity, type, and locations as input, then displays optimized routes with pickup sequences and efficiency metrics.
frontend/src/components/SmartEscrowPayme: Modal for buyers to create escrow-protected pre-harvest commitments. Displays listing details and allows quantity/price input, submitting via useMakeCommitment mutation with toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/TransportOpportu: Card component displaying harvest listing details for transporters, showing existing buyer commitments if any. Includes button to open MakeTransportOfferModal for submitting transport offers.
frontend/src/components/TransportTrackin: Modal dialog component for updating transport tracking information including current location, estimated delivery time, and status (Pending/In Transit/Delivered) for a transport offer.
Modal component that accepts natural language text input describing a harvest, uses AI to parse it into structured data (crop type, quantity, date, location), and applies the parsed data to a form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, providing login/logout functionality and tracking authentication status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, harvest listings, commitments, transport offers, buyer demands, yield predictions, route optimization, and crop analysis.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a green-based agri-tech color palette for light and dark modes, plus utility classes for cards, badges, inputs, and buttons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BuyerDashboard.tsx: Buyer dashboard page with tabs for browsing harvest listings, viewing commitments, and managing posted demands. Includes filtering, listing cards, and a modal to post new buyer demands.
frontend/src/pages/FarmerDashboard.tsx: Farmer dashboard page with tabs for managing harvest listings and viewing buyer demands. Includes modals for creating listings and crop diagnosis, plus predictive analytics for each listing.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero section, problem statement about crop spoilage, and solution explanation for pre-harvest commitments. Includes call-to-action buttons and feature cards.
Transporter dashboard page displaying available transport opportunities from harvest listings. Includes a route optimizer modal for planning efficient delivery routes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing. Includes sessionStorage persistence and parameter cleanup functions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, custom animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state file for HarvestSync, a web application coordinating perishable crop harvests between farmers, buyers, and transporters with Pre-Harvest Commitments. Tracks 31 versions, existing features (landing page, authentication, dashboards, commitment workflows, transport offers, demand requests), known issues (buyer commitments not displaying, Offer Transport button not working), and architectural notes about three user roles and Tailwind CSS styling.
